purpose: Reader names map to stable archive/program identifiers; identifiers remain unchanged.

R09.scope: Single branch after auxiliary-coefficient selection using each model inner validation; not fixed-alpha matched ablation.

R10.scope: The same selected-alpha branch and frozen DeiT; weights0.40 and0.60.

R11.scope: The same two frozen branches with one scalar weight per outer fold, chosen on the corresponding inner validation data.

matched_fixed_alpha_controls.A0_NATURAL: Natural CORAL without the auxiliary head
matched_fixed_alpha_controls.A3_GRADE_FIXED: Grade-value auxiliary supervision with fixed alpha0.125

warning: Fixed-alpha branches/fusions are not interchangeable with R09/R10/R11. The two fusion strategies run in parallel; R10 is not input to R11. Model role counts, analysis-stage IDs and system IDs refer to different levels.
